healthy_call.note: Normal answered call with clean bidirectional RTP.

nat_one_way_audio.note: Phone behind NAT advertises 192.168.1.50; PBX sends RTP there, caller hears nothing.

one_way_firewall.note: Answered call; PBX never sends RTP (e.g. blocked RTP port range).

codec_mismatch.note: Phone offers only G.729; PBX does not allow it.

auth_failure.note: Digest challenge answered with wrong credentials, then 403.

setup_timeout.note: Oversized INVITE over UDP to an unreachable trunk; retransmitted, never answered.

poor_quality.note: Congested WAN: heavy packet loss and jitter toward the caller.

register_auth_failure.note: Registration retried with credentials and challenged again: wrong password.

caller_cancelled.note: Caller hung up while ringing: normal, not a fault.
